questions.message: A full-time employee with less than 3 years’ service receives 27 days of annual leave, plus 8 bank holidays. [1]
Report by 09:30 on the first day of absence. Shift and on-call workers must report at least 1 hour before their shift or rota period starts. [1][2]

Submit your claim within 30 calendar days of when the expense was incurred. For a multi-day trip, submit all expenses together within 30 calendar days of the trip’s first expense. [1][2] Claims submitted 31–90 days later need a written explanation and Head of Department approval; claims submitted after 90 days are not reimbursed unless the Finance Director approves an exception. [1][2]
The Head of Workplace Experience owns the Standard. [1]
The Leave and Absence Standard, version 1.2, is currently in force. It took effect on 1 October 2026 and replaced the archived Leave Policy v1.0.[1]

Probation is 6 months from the start date. It may be extended once, by up to 3 months, if the manager needs more time to assess performance or absence has affected the assessment; the extension must be confirmed in writing before the original end date. [1]
Standard hours are 37.5 hours a week, or 7.5 hours a day, plus an unpaid 60-minute lunch. Core hours are 10:00–16:00, within a flexible working band of 07:30–19:00. [1]
Salary is paid on the 25th of each month. If the 25th falls on a weekend or bank holiday, it’s paid on the previous working day. [1]

Report it to the IT Service Desk immediately, and no later than 1 hour after discovering it. [1][2] If it was stolen, report the theft to police within 24 hours and record the crime reference number in the IT ticket. [1]
Passwords must be at least 14 characters, and MFA is mandatory for all Northstar systems. [1]
An employee can make up to 2 statutory flexible-working requests in any 12-month period. [1][2]
The annual learning budget is £1,000 per financial year. It is not reduced for part-time employees, and is pro-rated for employees who join part-way through the year. [1]
The 2026 company shutdown is Tuesday 29, Wednesday 30 and Thursday 31 December. [1][2]

The full-time annual allowance is 27 days of annual leave plus 8 bank holidays (35 days total). [1] Leave accrues at one-twelfth of the annual entitlement per complete calendar month, so your first-year accrued amount depends on your start date. [2]
Call your line manager by 09:30 on your first day off sick. If you work shifts or are on-call, call at least 1 hour before your shift or rota period starts. [1][2]

Yes. You can carry over up to 5 days (37.5 hours for a full-time employee, pro-rated for part-time) without approval, and must use them by 31 March of the next leave year. [1][2]

Exceptions apply if sickness or family-related leave prevented you taking leave, or the company asked you to defer it for exceptional business reasons. [1][2]
No. For an illness absence of three calendar days, complete a self-certification form in PeopleHub on the day you return; a fit note is required only for absences longer than seven calendar days. [1]

Yes. If you work hybrid or remotely and have completed probation, you can claim up to £300 (including VAT) once in any 3-year period for a desk, chair or other ergonomic equipment. Submit receipts through ExpenseFlow. [1][2][3]
Yes, but only with Public information. Don’t enter Northstar Internal, Confidential, personal or Restricted information into a free or consumer AI chatbot. [1][2]

You can take reasonable time off to deal with the unexpected nursery closure. It’s paid for up to 2 working days for this occurrence, subject to a maximum of 5 paid days in the leave year; notify your line manager by phone as soon as reasonably practicable. [1]

You get 55p per business mile for the first 10,000 business miles in the tax year, then 25p per mile after that. [1] Only business miles count; deduct your normal commute from each leg that starts or ends at home. [1]
No. Your leave is not approved unless PeopleHub shows “Approved.” If there’s no decision after 5 working days, PeopleHub automatically escalates it to the Head of Department. [1][2]

Yes. You can take hourly leave in whole-hour blocks, with a minimum of 1 hour. Up to 37.5 hours of your annual leave allowance per leave year can be taken this way, pro-rated for part-time employees. [1]

You can report suspected misconduct to your line manager, People Operations, or—where appropriate—through the whistleblowing channels: your Head of Department, the Head of Risk and Compliance at compliance@northstar.example, speakup@northstar.example, or the independent Speak Up line, available 24/7 through the intranet. [1][2]

Yes. The independent Speak Up line accepts anonymous reports. If you ask for your identity to be protected, Northstar will protect it unless disclosure is required by law. [1][3]
No. During probation, you receive SSP only, not company sick pay. [1][2]

With 4 years’ service, you can get 8 weeks at full pay, followed by 8 weeks at half pay in a rolling 12-month period. [1] Any company sick pay already paid in that period is deducted, and SSP is included in—not added to—company sick pay. [1] This applies if your contract includes the company sick pay scheme. [1]

You can take up to 2 weeks of paternity leave if you expect to have responsibility for your child’s upbringing. [1] Because you joined only 2 months before the due date, you won’t meet the 26-week service requirement by the qualifying week, so the leave will be unpaid; you may use annual leave instead. [1]
No. You must complete probation before you can work abroad; after that, Spain work still requires prior approval and must meet the other policy conditions. [1][2]

You must qualify for Statutory Maternity Pay and have at least 26 weeks’ continuous service at the end of the 15th week before your expected week of childbirth. [1]
- Weeks 1–16: full basic pay, inclusive of SMP.
- Weeks 17–39: SMP only.
- Weeks 40–52: unpaid. [1]
Yes. First class is permitted for a 4-hour journey with Head of Department pre-approval [1]. Get approval before incurring the cost and record it in ExpenseFlow as a “Travel and spend request” [2].

If your 4 years of service are continuous, you would have at least 5 years’ service by the proposed start date, so you may apply for a 2-month sabbatical. [1] Apply at least 3 months beforehand; approval is discretionary and depends on business needs. [1]
Do you mean you resigned in June 2026, or will resign in June 2027?

Yes. At 22:30, the taxi qualifies for reimbursement up to £50 per journey, provided it was a necessary Northstar business expense and you submit evidence. [1][2][3] A fare above £50 needs Head of Department approval. [2]

Yes, for carryover from 2026 into 2027, but only if an exception applies. [1][2]
- Sickness that prevented you taking leave: up to 20 additional days for a full-time employee, pro-rated for part-time; use within 18 months after the leave year ends. [1]
- Family-related leave: all untaken leave for the year may carry over; use within 12 months of returning to work. [1]
- Exceptional business reasons: up to 5 additional days (10 total), with Director of People Operations approval; request by 30 November and use by 30 June 2027. [1]
Have you completed probation?
No. G4 employees receive TOIL only, hour for hour, for approved overtime. [1]
No. You must decline the gift because it’s from a supplier whose contract you’re negotiating with, regardless of its value. [1]

Possibly. You may work from Italy only on tasks that do not involve Restricted data, unless the CISO approves access in writing and the customer contract permits it. [1][2] You also need prior approval from your line manager, People Operations and IT Security, and Italy must not be on the restricted-destination list. [3]

The 5 days booked after your leaving date are cancelled. [1] Your final holiday balance is calculated using leave taken or booked up to your leaving date; any positive balance is paid, and any negative balance may be deducted where your contract permits. [2][1]

You can request it, but a 3-working-day request during a published critical delivery period needs line manager and Head of Department approval and is normally approved only in exceptional circumstances. [1][2] You need to give at least 10 working days’ notice. [2]

Your total entitlement is **209.75 hours**: 130.171 hours for full-time (1 January–30 June) plus 79.397 hours for 22.5 hours/week (1 July–31 December), rounded up to the nearest 0.25 hour. [1]

After deducting 60 hours for bank holidays on your working days, you have **149.75 hours of bookable annual leave**. [1] After the 60 hours you’ve already taken, **89.75 hours remain**; reserve **7.5 hours** for the shutdown day on Wednesday 29 December. [1]

Get Director pre-approval for the international trip and complete the Travel desk travel-risk check. [1]

For the cash taxi, convert the euros to pounds using Finance’s published rate for that month and claim the converted amount. Taxis are reimbursable up to £50 per journey only in the listed circumstances, such as when public transport is unavailable or for safety or accessibility reasons; journeys over £50 need Head of Department approval. [2][3]

Call your line manager as soon as reasonably practicable, given you’re in a different time zone, and record the sickness in PeopleHub that day (or ask your manager to do it). [1][2] Provide self-certification if the sickness lasts up to 7 calendar days, or a fit note if it lasts longer. [1][3] The affected holiday days may then be reclassified as sickness and credited back; reporting only after you return usually won’t qualify. [1]

Your deadlines are:
- Return your equipment by Friday 27 November 2026, within 5 working days after your leaving date. [1][2]
- Submit outstanding expenses by Friday 4 December 2026, within 10 working days after your leaving date. [2]
- Your system and building access will be cut off at 17:30 on Friday 20 November 2026. [3]
- Any final holiday pay will be paid on Friday 25 December 2026, with your final adjustments. [4]

You may end the meeting or leave the site if you feel unsafe, and you won’t be penalised for doing so in good faith. [1] Follow the customer’s site incident procedure and report it to Northstar: customer harassment must be reported to your line manager and People Operations within 1 hour. [2][3]

No. I can’t analyze employees’ sickness records or diagnoses here. Health information must never be entered into a generative AI tool. Ask People Operations about an appropriate way to review absence patterns.

Northstar must allow you time off for jury service. If your absence would seriously harm the business, it may ask you to apply to defer; jury service can be deferred only once in a 12-month period. [1]

Northstar pays full basic pay for your first 10 working days of jury service in a leave year. After that, Northstar does not pay, and you may claim loss of earnings from the court. [1]

Tell your manager and upload a copy of your summons to PeopleHub within 2 working days of receiving it. [1]

For your first 4 weeks, you must attend at least 3 days per week. [1] I can’t confirm how much leave you can book by June or when a home-office allowance can be claimed from the available policy sources; please contact People Operations.
No. Pregnancy-related absences are excluded from attendance triggers. [1][2]
You can book **112.5 hours** of annual leave in 2027, after deducting bank holidays that fall on your working days. [1]
They get **23.0 days of annual leave**, plus **7 bank holidays** during their employment in 2027. [1][2]
Holiday pay due is **£612.50 gross**. [1][2]
Their bookable annual leave for 2027 is **191.75 hours**. [1]
They receive **£98.60 in SSP** for the 4 working days, with no company sick pay during probation. [1]
They receive 13 weeks at full pay (£1,000 per week), followed by 2 weeks at half pay (£500 per week), totaling £1,000 for weeks 14 and 15. [1] Company sick pay is inclusive of SSP. [2]
£342 is reimbursed. The claim needs approval from your line manager and Head of Department. [1] The £15 hotel excess is not reimbursed unless the Head of Department approves an exception. [1]
You can claim **£45.00**: the first 50 miles at 55p and the remaining 70 miles at 25p. [1][2]
No. You gave 9 working days’ notice, but 10 are required for 3 days off. It may still be approved at your manager’s discretion. [1][2]

Full-time: **6 office days** in the 4-week period (8 × 15 available working days ÷ 20 normal working days). [1]

Working 3 days a week: **3 office days**, assuming the 5 leave days are scheduled working days (8 × 3/5, adjusted for 7 available working days out of 12, then rounded up). [1]
Northstar must give 9 weeks’ notice: the statutory minimum is longer than the G2 contractual notice of 1 month. [1]
The statutory redundancy pay is £4,506: 6 full years × 1 week’s pay, using the £751 weekly pay cap. [1]
They get **8.0 days of annual leave** for 2027, with **3 days reserved for the shutdown**. They also receive the 27 and 28 December bank holidays as paid days off. [1]
A £1,200 claim needs approval from your line manager, Head of Department and Director. [1][2]
The hotel limit in Zurich is £300 per night. [1]
Right-to-work check copies are kept for the duration of employment plus 2 years. [1]
The highest data classification allowed in Northstar Knowledge Search is Internal. [1]
After probation, a G5 employee must give 2 months’ notice when resigning. Your individual employment contract prevails if it sets a different notice period. [1]
At the end of month 3, your manager holds a midpoint review. Any concerns are recorded in writing and support is offered; People Operations is involved if concerns exist. [1]
That is Severity 3 — Medium. Report it within 1 hour of discovery to the IT Service Desk or security@northstar.example. [1][2]
The dinner limit for Paris is £45. [1]
You may accept it, but must record it in the gifts and hospitality register within 5 working days. [1]
Recruitment records for unsuccessful candidates are kept for 6 months after the hiring decision. [1]

Under the standard rule, you can carry over up to 3 days (22.5 hours) at 0.6 FTE. Use it by 31 March of the next leave year. [1][2] Sickness, family-related leave or exceptional business reasons can allow additional carryover. [3]
Submit all outstanding expense claims within 10 working days after your leaving date. [1]
Which AI tool would you use, and is the log classified Confidential (not Restricted) with the customer contract permitting AI processing?
A business trip abroad at Northstar’s request for customer work does not count toward your 10 Work From Abroad days. [1]
Yes. You can claim an extra 5p per passenger per business mile for a colleague travelling with you on the same business journey. [1]
No. Northstar pays Statutory Shared Parental Pay only; there is no company enhancement. [1]
No. Home broadband is not reimbursable as part of hybrid working. [1][2]
Prompts and outputs in approved tools are kept for 90 days. [1]

The manager must acknowledge the request within 5 working days and meet with you within 4 weeks of receiving it. [1][2]
You may appeal within 10 working days of the decision. [1][2]
The decision and any appeal must be completed within 2 months of receiving the request, unless you agree to an extension. [1][2]

Follow the Leave and Absence Standard; it is the current authoritative procedure. [1] The archived Leave Policy was superseded effective 1 October 2026, so its search result should not be used for current decisions. [2]

Hybrid employees are provided a laptop, one external monitor, keyboard, mouse and headset. [1] They must return all equipment within 5 working days after their leaving date, using the prepaid courier arranged by IT. [2]
What type of leave are you asking about, and what dates or how many working days?
What kind of time off do you mean—sickness absence, annual leave, or something else?

Yes, you can request a permanent remote contract, but it needs approval from your Head of Department and People Operations. [1] Your contractual workplace must be in the UK. [1] You can apply through a statutory flexible-working request or as part of a role change. [1][2]
What was the expense, and what was it for?

You’re eligible for unpaid parental leave if you’re an employee with parental responsibility for the child. It’s a day-one right; you can take up to 18 weeks per child before their 18th birthday, subject to the limit of 4 weeks per child each year. [1]

During probation, give 1 week’s notice. After probation, give 1 month for grades G1–G3, 2 months for G4–G5, or 3 months for G6–G7. [1] Your individual employment contract prevails if it sets a different notice period. [1]
Do you mean taking it abroad without working, or working from abroad on it?
I can’t access your personal leave balance. Please check your HR system or contact People Operations.
No specific increase for April 2027 is stated. Salary increases are discretionary and not guaranteed, and changes are normally effective from 1 April. [1]
The available sources don’t cover the Leeds office Wi-Fi password. Please contact People Operations.
I can’t access your personal leave records, so I can’t tell whether it was approved. Please check the request status in PeopleHub.
The available sources don’t cover maternity policy for employees in the Republic of Ireland. Please contact People Operations for the applicable policy.
The sources don’t provide that figure. Please contact People Operations.
There’s no fixed bonus-pool amount stated. Northstar decides whether a pool exists and, if so, its amount. [1]
The available sources don’t say whether Northstar provides a company car. Please contact People Operations.
I can’t share a colleague’s health information or diagnosis. You can ask about the general sickness absence policy or your own absence.
I can’t share another employee’s salary. You can ask about your own pay or the salary review policy.
I can’t disclose employees’ performance information or identify who is on a performance improvement plan. I can explain the PIP policy instead.
No. Sickness records contain health information and must never be entered into any generative AI tool, including a free online tool. [1][2]
The sources don’t provide salary bands. Please contact People Operations.

The four headline numbers are:
- 27 days’ annual leave for full-time staff, plus 8 bank holidays. [1]
- 5 days’ carryover, to be used by 31 March. [1]
- 09:30 sickness-reporting deadline by phone or Teams call. [1]
- 8 office or customer-site days in every rolling 4-week period for hybrid roles. [1]

Yes. By 1 June, the employee has 3 complete months of service: 6.75 accrued days rounds up to 7.0, and line manager approval allows up to 2 additional days, for a total of 9.0 days. [1] Any leave period over 5 consecutive working days also needs Head of Department approval. [1]
MeetingScribe allows information up to Confidential. It can’t be used for HR, medical or whistleblowing meetings, or customer meetings without consent. [1]
Follow the policy document; a training slide is a summary and does not override it. [1][2]
No. You must complete probation before claiming the home office allowance [1][2] or working abroad [3].
With 3 years’ service, the employee gets 8 weeks at full pay, then 8 weeks at half pay in a rolling 12-month period. [1]
